purpose: Development set for Activities A-C and for tuning. Never part of the 30-query held-out evaluation set.
labelling_rules: required_evidence is a list of groups; each group is one fact the answer needs.
A group lists alternative evidence IDs; the group is satisfied if ANY of them is fully contained in a retrieved chunk.
Labels were written from the policy text only, before any retrieval results were seen.

queries.query: How far in advance do I have to request a two-week holiday?
queries.note: 'holiday' and 'two-week' vs the policy's 'annual leave' and '5 or more consecutive working days'.
Rare proper noun appearing once in the corpus; short query with little semantic content.

queries.query: What is the IT Service Desk's internal extension number?
queries.note: The extension (4357) is stated in two policies; either sentence answers the question.

queries.query: Can I use public Wi-Fi when working from home, and do I always need the VPN?
queries.note: Public Wi-Fi rule and the VPN-at-all-times rule are adjacent sentences.

queries.query: On a 7-hour business flight can I book premium economy, and how much can I spend on meals per day?
queries.note: Facts are in two different sections (4. Flights and Accommodation, 5. Meals).
